system.effect:
Prerequisites: Minor Gift – World’s Guardian
Daily – Standard Action
Target: A Trainer or Pokémon within 10 meters
Effect: You gain a +2 bonus to accuracy rolls against the Target, and a +5 bonus to damage rolls. In addition, if it is more than 5 meters away from you at the start of your turn, you may Teleport to any space adjacent to it as a Shift Action. These effects last until the end of the Scene.
